block.projecthero.launch_pad.hint: The Sky Fortress's ground post. Step onto it holding a Fortress Pass and it flings you straight up through the hangar's lift hatch.
block.projecthero.launch_pad.no_pass: The pad hums. It needs a Fortress Pass in your hand.
block.projecthero.launch_pad.clear: Nothing overhead to launch you to.
block.projecthero.launch_pad.step: Step onto the pad holding the pass.
block.projecthero.sky_turbine.hint: One of the four turbines in the Sky Fortress engine room. Hold right-click on it for 2 seconds to sabotage it. Kill all four and the shield over the Command Bridge stairs drops.
block.projecthero.sky_turbine.all_down: All four turbines are down. The bridge shield is failing!
block.projecthero.bridge_shield.hint: An energy wall over the stairs to the Command Bridge. It drops when every turbine in the engine room is sabotaged.
block.projecthero.sky_vault_seal.hint: Admiral Kestrel's Tier 4 vault. It opens when she falls. Each player then gets their own loot.
block.projecthero.sky_vault_seal.locked: Sealed. Admiral Kestrel still holds the flight deck.
block.projecthero.parachute_crate.hint: Right-click to take a Parachute (one at a time). Found by the Sky Fortress hangar mouth.
block.projecthero.wind_vent.hint: Set in the Sky Fortress flight deck. It hisses, then blasts a gust that shoves anyone in its lane toward the open edge. Sneak to halve the push.
item.projecthero.fortress_pass.hint: Hold it and step onto the Sky Fortress Launch Pad to be flung up to the hangar. Never used up.
item.projecthero.parachute.hint: Right-click in the air to open it. Carried anywhere in your inventory, it opens by itself after a 10-block fall. Gives 20 seconds of Slow Falling.
item.projecthero.parachute.ground: Jump first. A parachute opens in the air.
item.projecthero.kestrel_thruster.hint: Right-click: a burst of thrust where you look, a short glide and no fall damage. 15 second cooldown.
entity.projecthero.sky_prisoner.thanks.0: Pilot: "You came for me? Here, take this. I'm getting off this tub!"
entity.projecthero.sky_prisoner.thanks.1: Engineer: "Thank you! Take what I stashed. I've got a parachute and a long way down."
projecthero.sky_fortress.officer_down: The Deck Officer is down. Only the Admiral is left.
projecthero.sky_fortress.officer_rally: Deck Officer: "All hands to the bridge!"
projecthero.sky_fortress.kestrel.phase2: Admiral Kestrel: "Enough of the deck. Let's see you fight in MY sky!"
projecthero.sky_fortress.cleared.title: Sky Fortress Cleared
projecthero.sky_fortress.cleared.chat: The Fortress Vault in the Admiral's cabin is open. Each player gets their own loot.
projecthero.jei.sky_fortress: Found in the Sky Fortress, a Tier 4 dungeon flying high over plains, savanna and ocean.
projecthero.guide.structures.sky_fortres: Admiral Kestrel's flying fortress floats very high over plains, savanna and ocean. A guarded Launch Pad on the ground below flings you up to the hangar if you carry its Fortress Pass. Fliers can just fly up. A Dungeon Locator can point at it.
projecthero.guide.loot.dungeon.sky_fortr: Sky Fortress: a flying Tier 4 dungeon. Turbines, a cell block, the Deck Officer, then Admiral Kestrel on the flight deck. Its vault can give Kestrel's Thruster.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.sky.body: A second Tier 4 dungeon, about a 10-15 minute run, flying very high over plains, savanna and ocean. It is rare and the Dungeon Locator can track it. The whole fortress, Launch Pad included, is one alarm zone: sneak, sabotage its panels and kill the runners for a Ghost bonus.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.sky.launch.bo: A guarded Launch Pad post stands on the ground right under the fortress. Kill the Pad Sergeant for his Fortress Pass, hold it and step onto the pad: it flings you up through the hangar's lift hatch. Fliers can just fly up.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.sky.wings.bod: Hangar deck (parked jets, ceiling turrets, a sniper on the catwalk), then the engine room, the cell block, the stair hall up to the Command Bridge, and the open flight deck on top.
An energy shield blocks the stairs to the bridge. Hold right-click on each of the four engine turbines for 2 seconds to wreck them. When the last one dies the shield drops and the whole fortress lurches.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.sky.cells.bod: Prisoners sit in barred cells. Press a cell's button, walk in and right-click a prisoner to free them for a reward, or leave them. The Captain on guard carries the keycard for the bridge's flight-deck door.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.sky.officer.b: The mid-boss on the Command Bridge: sidearm volleys, a flashbang (step out of the white ring), a sabre lunge, and twice he radios for crew and buffs his guards. He switches to whoever hurts him most.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.sky.kestrel.b: The boss on the flight deck, in a heavy flight suit. She jet-dashes along an orange line, fires homing missile barrages (lock-on rings mark the targets) and calls fighter drones. Her strafing run paints a red lane down the deck: get out of it. At half health she takes to the air and circles the deck. Her dive marks a ring first, and after a dive she stays down for a moment, taking extra damage.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.sky.hazards.b: The flight deck has open edges, and wind vents blast gusts toward them (sneak to halve the push). Falling off without flight is a very long drop. Grab a Parachute from the crates by the hangar mouth: it opens by itself in a long fall.
When Kestrel falls, the sealed Fortress Vault in her cabin at the bow opens into a Tier 4 Hero Vault. Each player gets their own loot, plus a chance at Kestrel's Thruster.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.sky.a.kestrel: Kestrel's Thruster (Legendary, 20%): right-click for a burst of thrust where you look and a short glide. 15 s cooldown.
